'''April 2000 San Diego tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG invitational held in San Diego, California on 30 April 2000. [[Pat Garcia]] won it. It is known from Pat Garcia's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d712">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-09-vegas-slam-2000d712/ vegas-slam-2000], DeckTech (pat "Rowen" garcia, 9 May 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-09-vegas-slam-2000d712/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 30 April 2000
* '''Site:''' San Diego, California
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Players:''' 8
* '''Winner:''' [[Pat Garcia]]
